concept.title: Food, meals and social refreshments
concept.shortdesc: Services around food and drink, including food parcels, prepared meals, cooking help, cafes, coffee mornings and lunch clubs.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Attending coffee mornings and informal meet-ups over coffee, usually a regular weekly social event.
: Dropping in to have tea, coffee or cake and a friendly chat in company.
: Receiving free or low-cost food to take home, such as food parcels, boxes or bags, or choosing items from a larder or community food shop.
: Receiving prepared meals, whether home-cooked, delivered, takeaway or served, including for special diets.
: Learning to cook or getting help with preparing meals, including cookery classes, cooking clubs and support with meal preparation.
: Getting free or low-cost hot drinks, snacks, cake and light food, including using a cafe at a venue.
: Being served a lunch or a multi-course meal at a venue, described as the meal itself rather than a club or group.
: Social lunch clubs, lunch groups and gatherings to share a meal with other people.
